amendment.reason: Released Position physical-unit metadata conflicts with author raw-cm usage. No calibration inferred from plausible size, speed, firing or null results.
amendment.approved_change: Camera-observation-window scale-invariant raw-coordinate case; physical speed/running selection removed.

source.subject: M02
source.position_computation: Original raw XY only; declared metadata preserved but not used for physical-scale claims.
source.window_semantics: Supplied first-to-last camera timestamps, half-open; not a source-defined maze epoch.
source.upstream_limitations: Independent camera/TTL acquisition; author preprocessing includes confidence rejection, PCHIP filling and median filtering. No claim every finite released row is directly observed.

tracking.valid_pair: finite XY at both endpoints; strictly increasing finite timestamps; dt<=max_gap_seconds
tracking.interval: [t[i],t[i+1]) intersect fixed window; left-sample position; last sample never extended

grid.bounds: Per-axis min/max of raw left positions owning positive-duration valid pieces, behavior only
grid.binning: edges=np.linspace(min,max,n+1,dtype=float64); bin=searchsorted(edges,value,side='right')-1; exact upper endpoint assigned final bin; flat=5*x+y
grid.occupancy: math.fsum durations in original time order within each bin

selection.denominator: Total valid observed duration, not running time.
selection.ledger: All110 source units retained in numeric source-ID order; strings preserve canonical decimal rendering without aliases.
selection.precedence: Listed order; only first failing reason.
selection.zero_eligible: Completed honest status no_eligible_units with empty eligible axis and null means.

null.window: Single fixed camera window; duration must exceed40s.
null.unit_index: Zero-based rank of original integer unit ID among all110 IDs sorted numerically, not eligibility-dependent.
null.mapping: window_start + ((spike-window_start+offset) % window_duration); all original spikes in window before masking; reassignment to original tracking intervals
null.undefined: A zero-count shifted draw has false mask and zero numeric placeholder. Any undefined draw makes null mean, adjusted and p_upper null; do not redraw.
null.interpretation: Conditional elapsed-time-shift comparison, not proof of spatial specificity or universal bias correction.

information.p_upper: (1+count(shifted_information>=raw_information))/301; inclusive exact comparisons, no tolerance in decision
information.headline: Equal-unit means of accepted CSV receipts, not independent hidden endpoint targets; null/adjusted/p headline unavailable if any eligible required endpoint is undefined.

precision.linear_coherence: Sum of scalar bounds for adjusted=raw-null. P_upper decision/count is exact full-precision primitive replay; displayed p scalar tolerance only.
